name: Saimin Gakuen
source:
My name is Nobuo.
I have something of an ability.

What kind of ability, you ask?
The ability to change minds.

--------------------------------------------------
Nobuo has transferred to school with lots of cute girls
--------------------------------------------------

Today's day one at my new "gakuen".
Wonder what sort of sights I'll see.
Heh heh heh.

Word is that the school is full of kawaii girls.
I'm looking forward to them.


[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ173947.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我叫信夫。
我有一種特殊能力。

你問是什麼能力？
改變思想的能力。

--------------------------------------------------
信夫轉學到了一所有許多可愛女孩的學校。
--------------------------------------------------
今天是我來到新「學園」的第一天。
不知道會看到什麼樣的景色。
嘿嘿嘿。

聽說學校裡全是可愛女孩。
我很期待。

[來源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ173947.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
